Name: Witchy Town Buildings
Author: leafuelle
Description:
As part of the Modfest, I joined team Bog and made some town building retextures, using a mixture of my own assets and art alongside Bog's wonderful art from her farm buildings.

~

Info:

Currently replaces the town buldings in the Town, Forest and Mountain maps respectively.
This is a content patcher mod, there is no config to turn certain buildings off at the time of release.
Other maps/vanilla buildings aren't currently planned but I'm open to suggestions.

~

Compatibility:

As this is a retexture mod, this mod will work with town map adjustments to my knowledge (no testing with SVE or other mods has been done at the time of release)
Other town retexture mods are not compatible.

~

Permissions:
-You [b]are[/b] allowed to recolor my work for [b]personal use only[/b].\
-You are [b]not[/b] allowed to put my work into anything that uses generative AI. [b][u]I don't consent to the use of my project in anything related to AI.
[/u][/b]
